texts: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Today it's all about flags. Forty national flags are hiding behind a puzzle, and the pieces flip one by one. You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's play!
Kick-off! Here's your first flag. Any idea?
Yes! It's Japan. The red disc stands for the sun. The flag is called Hinomaru, the circle of the sun.
Take a good look. Which flag is this?
That's Canada. The maple leaf flag was adopted in 1965.
Easy one... or is it? Name this flag!
It's Brazil. The blue globe shows the night sky over Rio de Janeiro.
Eyes on the screen. What flag do we have here?
Correct answer: United Kingdom. The Union Jack combines the crosses of England, Scotland and Ireland.
You've seen this one before. Which flag?
Of course, it's Italy. Italians call their green, white and red flag Il Tricolore.
Quick! Which flag is this?
Boom! It's Germany. Its black, red and gold colours date back to the 19th century.
Trust your instinct. Name it!
Here it is: India. The blue wheel in the centre is the Ashoka Chakra, with 24 spokes.
Don't overthink it. Which flag is this?
You got it, it's Mexico. The eagle on a cactus eating a snake comes from an Aztec legend.
This one is a classic. Which flag?
Spot on! It's Australia. The big seven-pointed star is called the Commonwealth Star.
Last easy one! Which flag is this?
The answer is South Korea. The red and blue circle in the middle is a symbol of balance.
Medium round! Things get trickier. Which flag is this?
Yes! It's Turkey. A white crescent and star on a red field.
Look closely at the details. Which flag?
That's Greece. Its nine stripes are said to match the syllables of the motto Freedom or Death.
Ten seconds on the clock. Name this flag!
It's Sweden. The blue and gold Nordic cross is centuries old.
This one fools a lot of people. Which flag is it?
Correct answer: Switzerland. It is one of only two square national flags. The other belongs to Vatican City.
Can you get this one right? Which flag?
Of course, it's Argentina. The golden Sun of May sits between two light blue stripes.
Think carefully. What flag is this?
Boom! It's Portugal. The golden armillary sphere recalls Portugal's age of sea exploration.
Here's a tricky one. Name it!
Here it is: South Africa. Adopted in 1994, it uses six colours.
Got it already? Which flag is this?
You got it, it's Jamaica. It is the only national flag with no red, white or blue.
Keep that streak going! Which flag?
Spot on! It's Norway. Its red flag with a blue Nordic cross was adopted in 1821.
Last medium question! Which flag is this?
The answer is Ireland. Ivory Coast uses the same three colours, in reverse order.
Hard round! Only the experts from here. Which flag is this?
Yes! It's Nepal. It is the only national flag that is not a rectangle.
Not so easy now. Which flag?
That's Kenya. A Maasai shield and two spears stand for the defence of freedom.
Here's one for the experts. Name this flag!
It's Cyprus. It is one of the very few flags that show a map of the country.
Take your time... but not too much. Which flag?
Correct answer: Bhutan. The white dragon is Druk, the Thunder Dragon.
This one is a real head-scratcher. Which flag is it?
Of course, it's Kazakhstan. A golden sun and a steppe eagle fly on a sky blue field.
Big brain time! What flag is this?
Boom! It's Chile. Its single white star is known as the Lone Star.
Lock in your answer! Which flag?
Here it is: Finland. The blue cross on white is often linked to the country's lakes and snow.
Few people get this one. Do you?
You got it, it's New Zealand. The four red stars show the Southern Cross.
Are you still with me? Which flag is this?
Spot on! It's Sri Lanka. A golden lion holds a sword, with leaves in each corner.
Last hard one! Which flag?
The answer is Colombia. Yellow fills the top half, while blue and red share the bottom half.
Genius round! Only true masters get these. Which flag is this?
Yes! It's Kiribati. A frigatebird flies over a rising sun and Pacific waves.
Seriously tough now. Name this flag!
That's Mozambique. Its emblem shows a book, a hoe and a rifle on a yellow star.
If you know this one, you're a legend. Which flag?
It's Seychelles. Five bands fan out from the bottom left corner.
Deep cut! Which flag is this?
Correct answer: Eswatini. A shield and two spears lie across the middle stripe.
Here's a rare one. What is it?
Of course, it's Belize. Its coat of arms shows two woodcutters beside a mahogany tree.
No hints this time. Which flag?
Boom! It's Papua New Guinea. A bird of paradise and the Southern Cross on red and black.
Almost there! Which flag is this?
Here it is: Mauritius. Four horizontal stripes: red, blue, yellow and green.
Only a handful of people will get this. Which flag?
You got it, it's Kyrgyzstan. The sun has 40 rays, one for each of the 40 legendary Kyrgyz tribes.
Second to last! Name this flag!
Spot on! It's Bosnia and Herzegovina. The yellow triangle echoes the shape of the country.
Final question! Make it count. Which flag is this?
The answer is Uruguay. The Sun of May shines beside nine blue and white stripes.
And that's the last flag! How many did you get? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
